instruction: In VS Code, change the default tab size from 4 to 2 spaces in the editor settings

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting tab size to 2 by configuring 'editor.tabSize' to 2 in VSCode settings.json. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings metric to verify this numeric setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VSCode settings.json from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json using get_vm_file (file.py:74-143)

Metric check_json_settings (vscode.py:49-77) properly handles type='rule' parameter: framework calls get_rule (misc.py:88-92) which returns config['rules'], so metric receives {'expected': {'editor.tabSize': 2}} and correctly accesses expected['expected'] at line 67
Expected value {'editor.tabSize': 2} is semantically correct - this is the exact VSCode setting name and value for configuring tab size to 2 spaces
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (change tab size to 2) and evaluator verifies exactly this requirement by checking editor.tabSize == 2
Postconfig appropriately activates VSCode window, though not strictly required since settings.json is automatically persisted to disk when modified through VSCode UI
Data flow is correct and will work at runtime: get_vm_file fetches settings.json from VM -> check_json_settings loads JSON and verifies editor.tabSize == 2 using strict equality (line 74)
Logic is robust: metric handles missing keys correctly using sentinel pattern (lines 72-75) and uses strict equality for numeric comparison, returns 0.0 if key missing or value mismatched
